props.name: onSeek
props.description: Observes accepted actual native seek requests.

props.name: onTimeChange
props.description: Observes actual native time, throttled to at most 10 Hz during playback. No simulated timer.

props.name: onCueChange
props.description: Observes passage changes from actual native time; undefined describes timing gaps.

props.name: onPlaybackChange
props.description: Observes actual native playing/paused state, including cleanup.

props.name: onFollowChange
props.description: Observes actual follow policy/manual reading state.

props.name: className
props.description: Root classes. The player is container-responsive up to 820 px.

name: Trim Timeline
description: An audio trim editor where the waveform leads: drag in and out grips that snap to pauses, the clip lifts out of the recording and its length counts live.

props.name: media
props.type: { id: string; title: string; src?: string; duration: number; peaks: number[]; meta?: string } | null
props.description: The recording. peaks are 0–1 amplitudes evenly spaced over it (20–50 a second reads well). Without src the playhead runs silently on a clock. null shows the empty state.

props.name: defaultRange
props.default: a clip from 9 s to 31 s, cut in breaths
props.description: Starting in and out points in seconds. Reset returns here.

props.name: minLength
props.description: Shortest clip, in seconds.

props.name: step
props.description: Arrow-key nudge in seconds. Shift and Page Up/Down move a whole second.

props.name: snapToPauses
props.description: Dragged edges stick to pauses in the speech (quiet runs ≥ 0.28 s) within 10px; pauses are dotted on the ruler.

props.name: onRangeChange
props.description: Called after each finished change: a drag released, a key step, or I/O at the playhead.

props.name: onApply
props.type: (range: { start: number; end: number }, signal: AbortSignal) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Saves the clip. The button shows Saving, then Saved; a rejection shows Try again and keeps the range. The signal aborts on unmount or a newer save.

props.name: applyLabel
props.description: Primary button label.

props.name: onPlaybackChange
props.description: Called when preview playback starts or stops.

props.name: status
props.description: Host state for decoding the recording. Loading and error keep the waveform's height.

props.name: errorMessage
props.default: "The file is there, but its audio couldn’t be decoded. …"
props.description: Body copy for the error state.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows Try again in the error state.

props.name: onChooseMedia
props.description: Shows Choose a file in the empty state.

props.name: accent
props.description: The trim bracket, the played part of the clip, edge time chips and focus rings.

props.name: theme
props.description: Graphite or paper chrome.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root.

name: Agent Approval Sheet
description: A mobile sheet for an agent that paused on a risky step: the exact command, a risk meter, and Approve as a hold-to-confirm bar a pocket tap cannot trigger.

props.name: agent
props.description: Who is asking. Shown in the eyebrow and woven into the summary, the receipts and the link copy. The deploy command takes its name too.

props.name: request
props.description: The preset request. Chooses the default title, command, three facts and receipt wording. Anything in details replaces the preset.

props.name: risk
props.description: How serious the action is. Sets the three-bar risk meter and its one-line note.

props.name: holdDuration
props.description: Seconds the Approve bar must be held before it fills and approves. Clamped to 0.5 to 2. Releasing early springs the bar back.

props.name: status
props.description: Drive the sheet from outside. Changing it moves the sheet to that state without reporting a decision.

props.name: receipt
props.description: Fold a settled request into a receipt row and log it to the run. Off keeps the sheet open after the decision, and says it is not logged.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand colour, as a 6-digit hex. It fills the Approve control; its label takes the near-black or near-white ink with the higher WCAG contrast, so it stays at AA on any swatch. Unset, the default flips with the theme so Approve stays solid on a white sheet.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black sheet over a dimmed app, or the white inverse.

props.name: runId
props.description: The run the request belongs to. Shown in the eyebrow and in the ledger line under Approve.

props.name: pausedFor
props.description: How long the run has been paused, written as "Paused {pausedFor} ago" on the right of the header.

props.name: details
props.type: Partial<{ title: string; summary: string; command: { head: string; args?: [name, value][] }; facts: [Fact, Fact, Fact]; detail: string; done: string }>
props.description: Replace any part of the request's copy with your own: the title, summary, verbatim command (a bare head line plus aligned name and value lines), the three facts, the detail line and the approved receipt line. Unset fields keep the preset's copy.

props.name: onDecision
props.description: Called once when the person decides: by holding Approve, Deny, deferring, or the screen reader's activate action. Host status changes are not reported.

name: Native Attachment Review Tray
description: A dark React Native attachment tray under a chat: drawn file previews, a size meter that fills as you pick, live uploads and a send that flies into the thread.

props.name: files
props.description: Each { id, name, kind, bytes, status?, progress?, detail?, reason? }. kind: pdf, image, sheet, audio, doc. status: ready, uploading (with progress 0–1) or failed (with reason). Only ready files can be sent.

props.name: defaultSelected
props.description: Ids selected on mount.

props.name: maxFiles
props.description: Most files in one send. A pick past it is refused with a shake and a note.

props.name: maxBytes
props.description: Most bytes in one send (25 MB). The meter turns red and send is held past it.

props.name: recipient
props.description: Who the thread is with: the header and the tray's title.

props.name: messages
props.description: The conversation behind the tray: { id, from: "them" | "me", text, time }.

props.name: defaultNote
props.description: The note sent with the files.

props.name: tray
props.description: Drive the tray: open shows the files, closed folds it to the composer. A change plays like a tap.

props.name: onTrayChange
props.description: Called when the tray opens or folds, by the + button, a send or a driven `tray`.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Send { files, note, totalBytes }. Resolve and the tiles leave, the tray folds and the message lands in the thread; reject and everything stays with an error and a retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry a failed upload. The host updates the file's status and progress; the tile shows them.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Open the host's file picker. Without it the Browse button is hidden.

props.name: renderThumbnail
props.description: Draw a real preview (an Image) for a file. It fills a 116 × 92 rounded well on the tile and in the sent bubble.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: selection checks and ring, the size meter and the send button.

name: Live Delivery Sheet
description: A frosted React Native bottom sheet over a monochrome night map: an amber route draws in, the ETA counts up, and the sheet morphs from ETA pill to full order.

props.name: restaurant
props.description: Shown in the glass top chip and beside the kitchen pin.

props.name: orderNumber
props.description: Order number for the chip and the order card.

props.name: etaMinutes
props.description: Minutes to arrival at `progress`; counts down as the courier rides, with a rolling digit.

props.name: etaClock
props.description: Arrival clock time.

props.name: routeKm
props.description: Whole route length, for the live “km away” figure.

props.name: progress
props.description: How far along the route the courier is, 0–1. Drives the marker, trail, ring and timeline.

props.name: live
props.description: Simulate the courier riding on (paused under reduced motion).

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand colour: route, courier, progress, Call and the tip thumb. Everything else is greyscale.

props.name: courier
props.description: Name, rating, vehicle and delivery count.

props.name: steps
props.description: Four timeline steps with times; the last is the arrival.

props.name: items
props.description: Order lines: qty, name, optional detail, unit price.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency symbol.

props.name: deliveryFee
props.description: Delivery fee.

props.name: serviceFee
props.description: Service fee.

props.name: address
props.description: Delivery address.

props.name: note
props.description: Courier note, shown in quotes.

props.name: tips
props.description: Tip amounts for the sliding segmented picker; the total tweens.

props.name: initialSnap
props.description: Snap point the sheet springs up to on mount.

props.name: onSnapChange
props.description: Fired when a snap is chosen.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Back button.

props.name: onMessage
props.description: Message the courier.

props.name: onCall
props.description: Call the courier.

name: Budget Envelope
description: A dark React Native zero-based budget: tap an envelope, drag a ruler to move money, and watch Ready to Assign rebalance live before you save.

props.name: envelopes
props.description: Each { id, name, icon, budgeted, spent, lastPeriod? }. Icons: home, basket, fork, car, bolt, coins, ticket, gift. A new array replaces the accepted budgets.

props.name: income
props.description: Money in for the period. Whatever isn't in an envelope is Ready to Assign.

props.name: period
props.description: The period's name, used as the title and in the income line.

props.name: periodNote
props.description: Short note beside the period, shown in the kicker, the hero and the sheet.

props.name: currency
props.description: Symbol written before every amount.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount per notch of the ruler. Typed amounts keep their cents.

props.name: allowOverAssign
props.description: Let a budget take more than is ready to assign. Off, the ruler rubber-bands at the limit.

props.name: openId
props.description: Drive which envelope's sheet is open; null or an unknown id closes it. A change plays like a tap.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when an envelope opens or its sheet closes (tap, scrim, drag down, close button).

props.name: onBudgetChange
props.description: Save { envelopeId, name, from, to, readyToAssign }. Resolve to accept; reject and the sheet keeps the draft, shakes once and offers a retry.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the open envelope's segment and tile, the ruler's needle, the change pill and a balanced month.

name: Native Channel Thread
description: A dark React Native channel thread: a spine draws through the replies, Quote pins a reply above a glass composer, and your answer lands with sending, sent or retry.

props.name: channel
props.description: Channel name without the #: the header, the placeholder and the read-only line.

props.name: root
props.description: The message the thread hangs from: { id, author, time, text, reactions?, attachment?: { title, detail } }.

props.name: replies
props.description: Replies in order. A reply with quoteId shows the quoted reply above its text.

props.name: me
props.description: Your name, for your own replies (shown with the inverted avatar).

props.name: status
props.description: loading shows placeholder replies with one soft sweep; error shows a banner with Retry over the cached replies; unavailable makes the composer read-only.

props.name: statusMessage
props.description: The host's words for an error or a read-only thread.

props.name: defaultDraft
props.description: The reply waiting in the composer.

props.name: onSend
props.type: (reply: { text: string; quoteId?: string }) => Promise<void> | void
props.description: Post a reply. It appears at once marked Sending; resolve and it's marked Sent; reject and it stays with Not sent. Tap to retry.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Reload after an error; the host moves status through loading back to ready.

props.name: onReact
props.type: (messageId: string, kind: ReactionKind, mine: boolean) => void
props.description: Called when you add or remove a reaction (check, eyes, heart). Counts change at once.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the send button, your reactions and the bar on the reply you're quoting.

name: Assistant Chat
description: A monochrome dark React Native assistant chat: glass header and composer, one accent, replies that stream word by word, and a schedule card that draws in.

props.name: assistantName
props.description: Name in the glass header and accessibility labels.

props.name: assistantRole
props.description: Shown after the live dot; swaps to Thinking… / Writing… while replying.

props.name: dayLabel
props.description: Day separator above the thread.

props.name: messages
props.description: Initial thread. An assistant message may carry a `schedule` (CareSchedule) rendered as an inline card with a drawn SVG chart.

props.name: quickReplies
props.description: Glass chips above the composer; each sends its label and streams its reply.

props.name: fallbackReplies
props.description: Replies used in order for anything typed.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Composer placeholder.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand colour (6-digit hex): your bubbles, the send button and the chart’s key line. Everything else is neutral.

props.name: thinkingMs
props.description: How long the shimmering typing indicator shows before streaming starts. The live demo uses 700.

props.name: wordMs
props.description: Base delay between streamed words (punctuation pauses longer). The live demo uses 32.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Fired when a message or chip is sent.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Fired when the stop button interrupts a reply.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Back button in the header.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Fired by the schedule card’s reminder button.

props.name: onAttach
props.description: The composer’s + button.

props.name: onOpenLog
props.description: The header’s care-log button.

name: Hold-to-Pay Checkout Sheet
description: A dark React Native checkout sheet over a product page that animates in: cards deal in, totals count up, hold to pay morphs into a spinner, a check and a receipt pill.

props.name: items
props.description: Line items: name, optional detail and price.

props.name: cards
props.description: Wallet cards: id, name, kind, last four and card art ("fern", "kite" or "northwind").

props.name: delivery
props.description: Delivery methods for the segmented control: id, label, price and ETA copy.

props.name: onPay
props.description: Required to enable payment. Return success only after the payment is confirmed; the default demo explicitly supplies its own simulated provider.

props.name: merchant
props.description: Who's being paid.

props.name: product
props.description: The product page the sheet presents over.

props.name: initialDelivery
props.description: Selected delivery option id.

props.name: initialCard
props.description: Selected card id. Defaults to the first card.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand colour (6-digit hex): fills Buy now and the pay button, whose labels flip to black or white for contrast. Everything else is greyscale apart from the card faces.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency symbol.

props.name: declineOnce
props.description: Default demo only: cards whose first simulated attempt is declined. A host onPay determines actual payment outcomes.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Fired when the sheet is dragged down, closed or the backdrop is tapped.

props.name: onReceiptPress
props.description: Fired when the receipt pill is tapped.

props.name: initiallyOpen
props.description: Present the sheet once the product page has made its entrance.

name: Day Schedule Studio
description: A React Native day timeline: drag an event up or down, it snaps to 15-minute slots, flags clashes, leaves a ghost behind and confirms the move from a glass bar.

props.name: events
props.description: { id, title, detail, startMinute, endMinute, editable (default true), unavailableReason }. Locked events are hatched and can’t be dragged.

props.name: dayLabel
props.description: Date in the mono label above the title.

props.name: timezoneLabel
props.description: Shown after the date. Times are local; the component doesn’t convert zones.

props.name: title
props.description: Screen title.

props.name: dayStart
props.description: First minute of the visible window (08:00).

props.name: dayEnd
props.description: Last minute of the visible window (18:00). The hour height fits the window to the screen.

props.name: nowMinute
props.description: Where the accent now line sits. Leave it out on other days.

props.name: minuteStep
props.description: Drags and the step buttons snap to this many minutes.

props.name: allowOverlap
props.description: When false, a proposed time that overlaps another event can’t be confirmed; the clash is named in the bar either way.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand colour: the moving event’s rail and time, the now line and the confirm button.

props.name: onReschedule
props.description: Confirm a move: { event, startMinute, endMinute, conflicts }. Resolve and the event settles in its new place; reject and the proposal stays with the error and a retry.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Fires when an event is picked or the bar is closed.

name: Document Reader
description: A React Native document reader: real pages under a glass bar, a thumbnail strip you scrub to flip pages, and a download button that draws its progress, then saves.

props.name: file
props.default: Northwind MSA — v3 redline.pdf, 12 pages, 4.8 MB
props.description: id, name, kind label, sizeBytes, pages, modified and optional sharedBy.

props.name: renderPage
props.description: Renders one page at the given width (height is width × 1.414). Plug in your PDF or document renderer.

props.name: status
props.description: Preview state. Loading shows shimmering page skeletons; unsupported and error replace the pages with a panel and its action.

props.name: statusMessage
props.description: Overrides the explanation in the unsupported and error panels.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Downloads the file; call report with 0–1 as bytes arrive. Reject with an Error to show its message. Once saved, the button opens the file.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Open in another app.

props.name: onShare
props.description: Share sheet.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Retry from the error panel.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Back button in the glass top bar.

props.name: marks
props.description: Zero-based pages with comments or changes; each gets an accent dot in the page strip.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: download progress, the active page thumbnail and the redline insertion.

name: Focus Session Dial
description: A dark React Native focus timer: drag a lit dial to set the length, watch the arc run down with a glowing head, then log the minutes to today's goal.

props.name: intention
props.description: What the session is for; the screen's title (two lines at most).

props.name: project
props.description: Where the session is logged, shown as a chip and in the finished line.

props.name: sessionLabel
props.description: Mono kicker above the intention.

props.name: presets
props.description: Quick lengths in minutes under the dial (up to five, within 5 to maxMinutes).

props.name: defaultMinutes
props.description: Starting length in minutes.

props.name: maxMinutes
props.description: Minutes in one turn of the dial; lengths run from 5 to this.

props.name: initialPhase
props.description: Phase on mount. "running" or "paused" resumes a session already under way.

props.name: defaultElapsedSeconds
props.description: Seconds already focused when mounting part-way through a session.

props.name: phase
props.description: Drive the phase from outside; a change plays the same transition as a tap.

props.name: completedToday
props.description: Minutes of each session already finished today, drawn as segments of the daily goal.

props.name: dailyGoalMinutes
props.description: The day's focus goal in minutes.

props.name: defaultDoNotDisturb
props.description: Whether Do Not Disturb starts on.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the dial's arc, its glow, the live head and the live segment.

props.name: onPhaseChange
props.description: Called on every phase change, by a tap, the timer running out or a driven `phase`.

props.name: onMinutesChange
props.description: Called as the length changes (dial drag, preset, keyboard or accessibility action).

props.name: onDoNotDisturbChange
props.description: Called when the moon button is toggled.

props.name: onComplete
props.description: Called once when a session finishes, with planned and focused minutes and whether it ran out.

name: Weekly Habit Ledger
description: A React Native habit week: five rituals across seven days in one graphite ledger. Marks bloom with a drawn check, streaks count up, today’s column lights when done.

props.name: habits
props.description: Rows: { id, name, icon (book | move | moon | water | stretch | pen), target days a week (default 7), streak before today, paused }.

props.name: days
props.description: The seven days shown, Monday first: { date (ISO), label for screen readers }.

props.name: todayIndex
props.description: Which day is today. Its column is held in a band; later days can’t be marked yet.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled marks: habit id → seven booleans. Pair with onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial marks when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires with the whole week after a mark is saved (or at once when there is no onToggle).

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Persist one mark. The cell fills at once with a ring while it runs; reject and it empties again with a shake and a retry note under the habit.

props.name: weekLabel
props.description: Mono label above the title.

props.name: title
props.description: Screen title.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand colour: the week ring, today’s letter and the all-done moment. Marks stay white.

name: Prompt Journal
description: A React Native journal: reflection prompts as a deck you flick through, a ruled page that takes over while you write, a word ring and a keep button that remembers.

props.name: prompts
props.description: The deck: { id, title (short category), question, guidance }.

props.name: answers
props.description: Answers kept earlier: { promptId, text, updatedLabel }. They fill the page and mark their card “Kept 18:40”.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Controlled prompt. Pair with onSelectionChange.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: Prompt on top when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Fires when a card is flicked away or a dot is tapped.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Keep an answer: { prompt, text, previous }. Spinner while it runs; reject and the words stay with the error and a retry. Drafts are kept per prompt either way.

props.name: dateLabel
props.description: Mono label above the title.

props.name: title
props.description: Screen title.

props.name: streak
props.description: Days in a row with something kept, shown top right.

props.name: wordGoal
props.description: A gentle target the accent word ring fills toward. It never blocks keeping.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: Character limit. Over it, keeping waits with an explanation and nothing is cut.

props.name: timeLabel
props.description: Stamped on an answer kept now.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand colour: the keep button, the word ring, the caret and the kept dot.

name: Delivery Live Activity
description: A dark iOS lock screen: neutral-glass delivery Live Activity, a springing Dynamic Island, one lime accent, ETA counting up and a route that draws to the courier.

props.name: updates
props.description: The delivery's states in order: stage, ETA minutes, clock, route progress (0–1), headline and detail.

props.name: stops
props.description: Labelled points on the route, e.g. Picked up at 0, Nearby at 0.8, Arrived at 1.

props.name: appName
props.description: App shown on the card.

props.name: courierName
props.description: Courier's name, used in labels.

props.name: courierInitials
props.description: Initials in the avatar.

props.name: date
props.description: Lock-screen date line.

props.name: initialStep
props.description: Which update to start on.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand colour: app mark, route, courier, ETA. Everything else stays neutral.

props.name: nearbyAccent
props.description: Semantic colour the accent warms to while the courier is nearby.

props.name: showDemoControl
props.description: Show the small Next update pill that steps through updates.

props.name: alertSeconds
props.description: How long the island stays open after a stage change.

props.name: step
props.description: Show this update (an index into updates). Changing it moves the activity there and alerts through the island on a stage change, as a real push update would.

props.name: island
props.description: Open or fold the Dynamic Island when this changes; taps and update alerts still move it afterwards.

props.name: onOpenApp
props.description: Card tapped.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Fires when the demo control advances.

name: Meeting Preflight
description: A dark React Native pre-call screen: a live self-view with glass controls and a mic meter, background blur, readiness checks, device sheets and join.

props.name: room
props.description: id, title, formatted time and participants ({ id, name, inRoom }).

props.name: you
props.description: Your name; its initials fill the tile when the camera is off.

props.name: devices
props.description: Microphones, speakers and cameras: id, group, label, detail and available (false keeps it listed but not choosable).

props.name: defaultDevices
props.description: Starting device per group; the first available one otherwise.

props.name: onDeviceChange
props.description: A device was chosen in the sheet.

props.name: defaultMuted
props.description: Start muted.

props.name: defaultCameraOn
props.description: Start with the camera on.

props.name: defaultBackgroundBlur
props.description: Start with the background blurred.

props.name: onMutedChange
props.description: The mic button was toggled.

props.name: onCameraChange
props.description: The camera button was toggled.

props.name: onBackgroundBlurChange
props.description: Background blur was toggled.

props.name: checks
props.description: Readiness: id, label, detail and status (ready, warning, blocked). A blocked check stops Join and says why.

props.name: preview
props.description: Your live camera view. Without one, a drawn self-view stands in.

props.name: micLevel
props.description: Subscribe to the live mic level (0–1); return an unsubscribe. The meter stays flat without it.

props.name: onJoin
props.description: Join with the room id, mute, camera, blur and chosen device ids. Resolve when you're in; Cancel aborts the signal; a rejection keeps every setting and offers Retry.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Close button.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one hue: the live mic level, the start-time dot and the ready ticks.

name: Mood Check-in Map
description: A React Native mood check-in: drag a light across an energy × pleasantness map, it lands on a named feeling, colours the field and logs onto today’s strip.

props.name: feelings
props.description: Named feelings placed on the map: id, label, a one-line description, pleasantness and energy (each −1 to 1). Invalid coordinates are left off the map.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled feeling id. Pair with onValueChange; a change from outside springs the light to that feeling.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Feeling selected on mount when uncontrolled. With none, the readout invites a first pick.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires when a drag settles on a feeling or a word is tapped, not on every frame of a drag.

props.name: log
props.description: Today’s earlier check-ins ({ id, feelingId, minute }), drawn as coloured dots on the 06:00–24:00 strip.

props.name: nowMinute
props.description: When this check-in happens, in minutes after midnight. Marks “now” on the strip and stamps the saved entry.

props.name: dateLabel
props.description: Date shown above the title, with the time of nowMinute.

props.name: title
props.description: The question at the top.

props.name: colors
props.description: The four corner colours (highPleasant, highUnpleasant, lowPleasant, lowUnpleasant). They are data colours: every feeling’s colour is blended from them by position. Everything else stays neutral.

props.name: defaultNote
props.description: Initial note text.

props.name: notePlaceholder
props.description: Placeholder for the optional note.

props.name: maxNoteLength
props.description: Character limit for the note. Over it, logging is held with an explanation and the note is kept in full.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Logs { feeling, note, minute }. While it runs the button shows a spinner; on success a dot lands on the strip. Reject to show the error and a retry with the note intact. The signal aborts on unmount.

name: Notification Digest

props.description: Large title.

props.name: date
props.description: Line above the title.

props.name: since
props.description: When the summary starts; used in the default subtitle.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Line under the title; defaults to "9 notifications since 13:00", counted from the groups.

props.name: groups
props.default: Messages, Linear, Northline, Halden, Kiln & Co.
props.description: One pile per app: { id, app, icon: "tasks" | "chat" | "calendar" | "bank" | "transit" | "parcel", items: { id, title, body, time, timeSensitive? }[] }.

props.name: snoozeOptions
props.default: In an hour, later this evening, tomorrow morning
props.description: Choices in the snooze sheet: { id, label, until }.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Id of a pile that starts fanned out.

props.name: nextSummary
props.description: Shown in the caught-up state.

props.name: accent
props.description: Time-sensitive marks, the progress ring and Undo. The only hue.

props.name: onRead
props.description: Called when a notification is swiped away or marked read. Reject or throw and it comes back with the error in the toast.

props.name: onSnooze
props.type: (item: DigestItem, group: DigestGroup, option: DigestSnoozeOption) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Called with the chosen option. Reject or throw and it comes back.

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Undo from the toast: the notification is back in the digest.

name: Now Playing
description: A dark React Native Now Playing screen: near-black glass lit by the cover's colours, white controls, a choreographed entrance, a growing scrubber and synced lyrics.

props.name: tracks
props.description: Queue: title, artist, album, duration, cover style, palette (four glow colours, used as dim ambient light) and timed lyrics or an instrumental note.

props.name: source
props.description: Playlist or album the queue plays from.

props.name: sourceLabel
props.description: Small caps line above the source.

props.name: initialIndex
props.description: Track to start on.

props.name: initialTime
props.description: Seconds into the first track.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Start playing on mount.

props.name: initialVolume
props.description: Starting volume, 0–1.

props.name: ambience
props.description: How strongly the cover lights the screen, from 0 (pure black glass) to 1.

props.name: devices
props.description: Rows in the AirPlay popover: name, detail and kind (phone, speaker, mini, display).

props.name: initialDeviceId
props.description: Device playing at mount; the first device is treated as local.

props.name: qualityBadge
props.description: Badge under the scrubber. Pass "" to hide it.

props.name: view
props.description: Puts the screen in a view: the plain player, synced lyrics, or the AirPlay or Up next popover. Taps still work; mirror them back with onViewChange.

props.name: onViewChange
props.description: The visible view changed, from a tap or from the view prop.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Chevron in the header.

props.name: onMore
props.description: Ellipsis button in the header.

props.name: onFavoriteChange
props.description: Star toggled.

props.name: onDeviceChange
props.description: A different AirPlay device was chosen.

props.name: onVolumeChange
props.description: Volume dragged or stepped, 0–1.

name: Native Offline Outbox
description: A React Native outbox for changes saved offline: a segmented ring fills as each change sends, rows check and fold away, and a glass sheet fixes a rejected note.

props.name: items
props.default: Five changes from a boiler service: a photo, a reading, job notes, a signature and a status change
props.description: Changes saved on the phone: id, kind (photo, reading, note, signature, status), title, detail, sizeBytes, queuedAt, optional editable body and an earlier error.

props.name: network
props.description: The phone's connection. Wi-Fi drains the queue by itself, mobile data waits for Send now, offline waits.

props.name: onSend
props.description: Sends one change (with any edited body). Reject with an Error whose message explains the failure; the change stays on the phone and is marked for attention.

props.name: onDiscard
props.description: The person discarded a change after a two-tap confirm.

props.name: context
props.description: Small mono context line above the title.

props.name: title
props.description: Screen title.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the queue ring's sent arcs, progress fills and spinners.

name: Packing List
description: A dark React Native packing list: check an item and it flies into a drawn carry-on that fills toward the airline limit, under a glass header that warns when over.

props.name: trip
props.default: Lisbon, carry-on, 7 kg limit, 3 kg bag
props.description: { destination, dates, bag, limitKg, tareKg }. The empty bag's weight counts from the start.

props.name: items
props.description: { id, name, detail?, group, qty (1–99), grams (one item), packed }. Sections keep the order their group first appears.

props.name: accent
props.description: The bag's fill, checks, progress and stepper. Over the limit the bag and weight turn red regardless.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Every change with the whole list after it; change is pack, unpack, quantity, remove or restore. Reject or throw and the list rolls back with the error in the toast.

props.name: onBack
props.description: The back button in the glass header.

name: Night Sky Paywall
description: A dark, monochrome React Native paywall: a moonlit lake in true greys, a glass plan picker, amber only on the CTA and selection, prices that count and roll.

props.name: kicker
props.description: Mono kicker beside the greyscale crescent.

props.name: title
props.description: Headline over the sky.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: One-sentence promise under the headline (hidden under 800pt tall).

props.name: features
props.description: Rows of { icon: sound | alarm | story | offline, title }; they blur in on a stagger as their icons draw on.

props.name: currency
props.description: Currency symbol.

props.name: annualPrice
props.description: Yearly price; the per-month figure and the savings badge are derived from it.

props.name: monthlyPrice
props.description: Monthly price.

props.name: trialDays
props.description: Free trial on the yearly plan.

props.name: trialEnds
props.description: Human date the trial ends, used in the terms line and success copy.

props.name: initialPlan
props.description: Preselected plan.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour (6-digit hex): the call to action, the selected plan's ring, wash and radio, and the saving badge.

props.name: onSubscribe
props.description: Drives loading → success; a rejection shows the error state with its message.

props.name: onRestore
props.description: Restore purchases; the link reads Restoring…, then Restored or Nothing to restore.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Close button.

props.name: onTerms
props.description: Terms link.

props.name: onPrivacy
props.description: Privacy link.

props.name: onContinue
props.description: The button after a successful purchase.

name: Project Switcher
description: A React Native project switcher: a glass sheet over the receding project home, searchable rows, and a pick that flies its mark into the header as the home re-lights.

props.name: projects
props.default: Six Northwind projects: Atlas iOS, Ledger Web, Dispatch API, Harbor Design System, Payments Compliance (locked) and Marketing Site
props.description: id, name, kind, glyph (triangle, ledger, signal, grid, shield, wave), openIssues, issuesDelta, cycle { name, progress, ends }, activity (7 values), recent items, members, updated, pinned and locked (the reason).

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled current project id.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting project when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Switches project. A promise holds the row's spinner until it resolves; a rejection shows its message on the row and keeps the current project.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled sheet visibility.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Starts with the sheet up.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: The sheet opened or closed (header tap, close, scrim, drag or a pick).

props.name: onRequestAccess
props.description: Ask on a locked project's row.

props.name: workspace
props.description: Workspace name in the header and section label.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the cycle ring, the busiest day and the current project's check.

name: Reading Progress
description: A dark React Native reading screen: a drawn cover, the book’s page edge you drag to flip to any page, bookmark ribbons, chapters and a glass resume bar.

props.name: book
props.description: id, title, author, total pages and the cover's own colours ({ top, bottom, ink }).

props.name: chapters
props.description: Chapters in order: id, title and first page; each runs until the next begins.

props.name: currentPage
props.description: The page the reader is on. Drives the read part of the page edge, the percentage and the current chapter.

props.name: minutesPerPage
props.description: The reader's pace, for time left in the book and in the chapter.

props.name: bookmarks
props.description: Controlled bookmarks ({ id, page, excerpt? }); pair with onBookmarksChange.

props.name: defaultBookmarks
props.description: Initial bookmarks when uncontrolled.

props.name: onBookmarksChange
props.description: The ribbon button added or removed a bookmark on the chosen page.

props.name: onResume
props.type: (destination: { bookId, chapterId, page }, signal: AbortSignal) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Open the reader at the chosen page: your place, or wherever the page edge, a chapter or a bookmark pointed. The button shows opening (tap to cancel, which aborts the signal), opened or failed.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one hue in the chrome: bookmark ribbons, the current chapter mark and the drag caret.

props.name: defaultTab
props.description: List shown first.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Back to the library.

name: Review Annotations
description: A dark React Native design review: numbered pins drop onto the artwork, the camera glides to each, glass comment cards ride over it, and you tap to pin new notes.

props.name: asset
props.description: { title, version, detail } for the navigation bar.

props.name: artwork
props.description: The image under review; it fills the frame and moves with the camera.

props.name: aspectRatio
props.description: Width over height of the artwork. The frame keeps it, up to the height a short screen allows.

props.name: annotations
props.description: { id, x, y, author, initials, text, time, replies?, resolved? }. x and y place the pin's tip, 0–1 from the artwork's top-left.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: The comment shown first. Defaults to the first open one.

props.name: accent
props.description: Open pins, the selection and Post. The only hue besides the artwork.

props.name: viewerInitials
props.description: Your initials on new comments.

props.name: onResolve
props.description: Resolve or reopen. Reject or throw and the pin goes back, with the error on its card.

props.name: onAdd
props.type: (draft: { x, y, text }) => ReviewAnnotation | void | Promise<ReviewAnnotation | void>
props.description: Posts a new pin. Resolve with the saved annotation (or nothing to keep the local one); reject and the draft stays with the error.

props.name: onBack
props.description: The glass back button.

name: Swipe Inbox
description: A monochrome, dark-first React Native inbox: rows rise from blur, swipe actions fill at their thresholds, a full swipe archives with glass undo, and new mail lands.

props.name: items
props.description: Rows: id, sender, subject, preview, time, unread, pinned, attachment. Avatars are greyscale initials.

props.name: title
props.description: Large title, which condenses into the glass bar on scroll.

props.name: dateLine
props.description: Line under the title until the first refresh.

props.name: incoming
props.description: The message that arrives after a pull to refresh.

props.name: theme
props.description: Dark by default; the light palette is tuned separately, not inverted.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: unread dots, links, the Read action and the lifted row's ring. Everything else is greyscale.

props.name: undoWindow
props.description: Milliseconds the undo toast stays up; its ring counts down.

props.name: hint
props.description: Nudge the first Today row once after the entrance to show the actions underneath.

props.name: onArchive
props.description: Fired when a row is archived (full swipe or the Archive action).

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Fired when Undo restores a row.

props.name: onPinChange
props.description: Fired when a row moves in or out of Pinned.

props.name: onReadChange
props.description: Fired by the leading swipe.

props.name: onReorder
props.description: Fired after a long-press reorder within Pinned or Today.

props.name: onRefresh
props.description: Fired when a pull passes the threshold.

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Fired when a row is tapped.

name: Sync Conflict Merge
description: A dark React Native sync conflict: drag one version of a field over the other to keep it, watch the shared event fill in, then merge and sync.

props.name: title
props.description: The record in conflict, set large in the event card.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Where the record lives, under the title.

props.name: mine
props.description: This device's edit: { name, initials, device: "phone" | "laptop" | "tablet", deviceName, editedAt }.

props.name: theirs
props.description: The other edit, same shape.

props.name: fields
props.description: Fields both sides changed: { id, label, mine, theirs }. Changed words are highlighted on each card.

props.name: settled
props.description: Fields both versions agree on, shown in the event card for context: { label, value }.

props.name: showSettled
props.description: Show the settled fields in the event card.

props.name: defaultChoices
props.description: Choices already made, by field id, for a resumed review.

props.name: accent
props.description: Marks changed words, the field in play and progress. The only hue.

props.name: onChoose
props.description: Called on every choice with { fieldId, choice, value }, so a host can keep the draft.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Saves the merged record. Resolve to show Synced; reject or throw and the choices stay, with the error message and a retry.

props.name: onBack
props.description: The glass back button.

name: Task Status Rail
description: A React Native task move: drag a glass puck down a workflow rail, the status glyph fills as it travels, locked columns refuse, and the move lands with a timed undo.

props.name: task
props.default: LED-412 · Compress hero images on /pricing, in progress
props.description: The issue: id, key, title, description, assignee, priority, due, subtasks { done, total } and its current status id.

props.name: statuses
props.default: Backlog, Todo, In progress, In review (limit 4), Done (needs an approved review)

props.name: initialStatus
props.description: Starting column id, overriding task.status. Read on mount.

props.name: onMove
props.description: Moves the task. Reject with an Error to keep it in place; the message is shown and the note is kept.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Puts the task back; offered for undoSeconds after a move.

props.name: undoSeconds
props.description: How long the undo ring runs after a move.

props.name: context
props.description: Mono context line in the top bar.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the puck's light, the lit rail, Done, subtask progress and the undo ring.

name: Trip Itinerary
description: A dark React Native trip itinerary: a route map that draws itself, a timeline line that draws as you scroll, local times per zone and delays in amber.

props.name: title
props.description: Trip name, shown as the large title and in the glass bar once it scrolls away.

props.name: dates
props.description: Formatted date range above the title.

props.name: legs
props.description: Legs in travel order: id, mode (train, flight, ferry, car), carrier, from/to places (name, code, IANA timeZone, lat, lon), ISO departs/arrives, optional revised times, status, note, details and action label.

props.name: now
props.description: ISO instant that decides the next leg and where you are on the map. Defaults to the device clock.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for local clocks, zone names and day headers.

props.name: tightConnection
props.description: Connections shorter than this many minutes are flagged in amber.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one hue: your position on the route and the drawn timeline line.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Back button.

description: A dark React Native voice memo: drag the waveform under a fixed playhead to scrub, a transcript that lights word by word, markers and a glass transport.

props.description: The memo: id, title, recordedAt label, optional place, duration in seconds, measured peaks (0–1, evenly spaced), markers ({ id, at, label }) and transcript sentences ({ id, start, end, text }).

props.name: initialPosition
props.description: Seconds into the recording when the screen opens; the playhead glides there on first view.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Start playing once the entrance has settled.

props.name: initialRate

props.description: Play, pause, or the end of the recording. Mirror it into your audio engine.

props.name: onSeek
props.description: A scrub, waveform tap, transcript line, marker or skip landed on this second.

props.name: onRateChange
props.description: The speed chip changed the playback rate.

props.name: onMarkerAdd
props.description: The flag button dropped a marker at the playhead.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Back chevron in the header.

props.name: onShare
props.description: Share button in the header.

description: A React Native wallet of engraved cards drawn in code on a neutral dark stage: they deal in, a tapped card lifts to the top and its balance and activity count in.

props.name: cards
props.description: Cards and passes: issuer, label, peek field, kind, pattern (guilloche | contour | rings | halftone | brushed), face colours (3–4 gradient stops, ink, accent), figure, meta and transactions. Card faces are the only colour on screen.

props.description: Large title. A long one stays on one line beside the add button, shrinking to fit before it truncates.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Line under the title. Defaults to a count of the cards shown.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Fired from the glass add menu.

props.name: onOpenCard
props.description: Fired when a card lifts out of the stack.

props.name: onSeeAll
props.description: Fired by See all in the detail view.

description: A multi-select where each pick's code badge flies from its row into the field as a chip, with a tri-state select-all, grouped search, Backspace removal and a +3 fold.

props.name: label
props.description: Mono label above the field, and the accessible name of the list.

props.name: grouped

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Field placeholder while searchable.

props.name: pickerPlaceholder
props.description: Field placeholder while not searchable and nothing is picked.

props.description: What one option is called, singular then plural. Used in the select-all row, the empty state and announcements.

props.name: metaLabel
props.description: Mono note over the meta column, on the first group heading.

props.name: defaultOpen

props.name: accent

props.name: accentInk

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale palette for the field, chips and sheet.

props.name: sections
props.description: Unique section IDs, optional icons and disabled reasons, and item lists. Empty lists receive a deliberate empty state.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the primary icon navigation.

props.name: brand
props.description: Workspace name used in the compact identity and context heading.

props.name: value

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled section and item selection.

props.name: defaultCollapsed

props.name: onCollapsedChange

props.name: status

props.name: theme
props.description: Neutral metallic surface palette.

props.name: density
props.description: 70px or 56px destination rows, both with touch-sized targets.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the outer container.

props.name: items
props.default: Home, Inbox, Calendar, Notes, Files, Focus (disabled), Settings
props.description: Unique id, label and icon (any ReactNode). Optional tile material (light, dark, paper), badge, running dot, a divider before it (separated), and disabled with a reason that becomes its label.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled current item (aria-current). Update it once onActivate resolves.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled current item.

props.name: onActivate

props.name: labels

props.name: lens
props.description: The glass lens that rides with the pointer over the swelling tiles.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks every item; names and reasons still show.

props.name: accent
props.description: Badges and the calendar weekday.

props.name: theme
props.description: Frosted graphite or frosted white plate, labels and lens.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the measured outer container.

props.name: onOrderChange

props.name: tabWidth

props.name: panelHeight

props.name: theme
props.description: Palette.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root.

props.name: defaultValue

props.name: onValueChange

props.description: The largest size in px (24–240). The type shrinks to fit its container's width from the measured widest line, and never grows past this.

props.name: direction
props.description: Fill word by word in reading order with a feathered leading edge, or let every letter fill from its baseline at once.

props.name: accent
props.description: The ink colour. Defaults to the theme's ink; passing either theme's ink follows the theme.

props.name: theme
props.description: Ink and outline for dark or light pages.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root, for width and placement.

name: Path Typesetter
description: Type on a curve at display size: drag the Bézier’s anchors and handles and the phrase reflows live, with shapes that morph, fit-to-path and tracking.

props.name: text
props.description: Controlled phrase. Omit to let the field own it.

props.name: defaultText
props.description: Initial phrase when uncontrolled. Whitespace is collapsed on the path; the plain phrase stays available to assistive tech.

props.name: onTextChange
props.description: Called as the phrase is edited.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled layout { path, size, tracking, align }. path is a cubic Bézier { start, c1, c2, end } in 0–1 canvas coordinates; size is in canvas units (the canvas is 1000 wide); tracking is in em; align is start | middle | end.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial layout when uncontrolled; anything missing comes from shape and fontRole.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every change, including each frame of a drag or a shape morph.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: Once a change settles: a drag ends, a key step, a slider release, a shape lands, Fit.

props.name: shape
props.description: Starting curve when no path is given. The shape buttons morph between these.

props.name: fontRole
props.description: Font role for the set phrase; changing it resets the size to suit the role’s width.

props.name: showGuides
props.description: Show the path, arms and handles at rest. Off, they appear while the canvas is hovered or a handle has focus.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the handles, the field and the settings while the phrase stays readable.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: handles, the live arm and the selected shape.

props.name: theme
props.description: Graphite canvas or warm paper.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root.

name: ASCII Object
description: A Three.js torus knot drawn in mono characters that resolve row by row out of a scramble, with edge-aware stroke glyphs, an accent torch and drag-to-spin.
usage: import { ThreeAsciiObject } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-ascii-object";

props.name: shape
props.description: A 2,3 torus knot, or a square torus with chamfered edges twisted three quarter-turns.

props.name: ramp
props.description: Characters from empty to dense; the first should be a space. ASCII_RAMPS exports classic, fine and blocks. Updates live.

props.name: cellSize
props.description: Character cell height in CSS px; width is 0.6×. Rounded to whole device pixels so glyphs stay crisp. Updates live.

props.name: color
props.description: Glyph tint, neutral white by default. Brightness within the tint follows the lighting.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: glyphs lit by the pointer's torch lean toward it (up to 80%).

props.name: background
props.description: Fill behind the glyphs.

props.name: edges
props.description: Draw silhouettes and self-overlaps with directional stroke glyphs ( - / | \ ) found by a depth Sobel.

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Idle spin in rad/s; resumes 1.2s after a drag. 0 holds still.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Drag to turn with inertia, hover torch, arrow-key nudges.

props.name: onGridChange
props.description: Called when the character grid changes size.

props.name: onReveal
props.description: Fires once as the glyphs start to resolve on first view, so surrounding UI can follow.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible description; a sensible default names the shape.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the host, which fills its parent.

name: Contour Terrain
description: A drifting Three.js landscape drawn only in contour lines that sweep in from the viewer. Click to raise a survey pin whose contours redraw outward.
usage: import { ThreeContourTerrain } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-contour-terrain";

props.name: title
props.description: Sheet title, top left.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Second line under the title.

props.name: origin
props.description: Latitude and longitude at the map's centre, for the readout.

props.name: baseElevation
props.description: Elevation of terrain height 0, in metres.

props.name: interval
props.description: Contour interval in metres; every fifth line is an index contour.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Minor contour colour, drawn at 46%. Neutral white by default.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: index contours, pin ripples, pin labels and the legend swatch.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed multiplier; 0 holds the map still.

props.name: maxPins
props.description: Pins kept at once (up to 7); the oldest sinks back when exceeded.

props.name: seed
props.description: Terrain seed.

props.name: chrome
props.description: Sheet header, legend, scale bar, pin count and Clear button.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which fills its parent.

name: Exploded Assembly
description: An exploded-view drawing in Three.js: parts drop into place, separate along their vectors as numbered balloons draw out, with a live parts list.

props.name: parts
props.description: 1–12 parts: { id, label, description, kind (box | cylinder | frame), size, position, explode, color, material?, metalness? } in model units.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled view { selectedId | null, separation 0–1 in 0.01 steps, azimuth −75…75 }.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial view when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first part, assembled, turned 25°.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every requested view. Throw to refuse it; the pose stays.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: A finished interaction the host accepted: a drag released, a key let go, a part picked, Reassemble.

props.name: title
props.description: The assembly's name in the toolbar.

props.name: path
props.description: Breadcrumb before the title.

props.name: unit
props.description: How model units read in the parts list, the size note and the stack height.

props.name: quality
props.description: Drawing-buffer budget: 400k or 800k pixels, DPR capped at 1.5 or 2, 2048px a side.

props.name: accent
props.description: Selected part's edges, balloon and list marker.

props.name: theme
props.description: Chrome and studio backdrop.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the view; the parts list and notes stay readable.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Route Globe
description: A grey dotted Three.js globe from real coastlines: land spreads out on first view, then accent arcs draw between cities, with comets, labelled markers and drag-to-spin.

props.name: routes
props.type: { from: [lat, lon]; to: [lat, lon]; fromLabel?: string; toLabel?: string }[]
props.description: Great-circle arcs with a travelling comet. Unique endpoints get a pulsing marker; labels show on hover, tap or keyboard turn.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour on the globe: arcs, comets and markers. Land, rim and atmosphere stay grey.

props.name: focus
props.description: Latitude and longitude that face the camera on mount; the land reveal spreads out from here.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for rotation and comet speed; 0 stops auto-rotation.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Drag or arrow keys to spin with inertia and tilt.

props.name: maxRoutes
props.description: Draw only the first N routes, so a sparser network can be shown without editing the array.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; the route count and controls are appended.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which fills its parent.

name: Holo Metal Card
description: A brushed-metal membership card in Three.js with thin-film foil and etched type. It turns in out of the dark under a passing glint, tilts and flips.
usage: import { ThreeHoloCard } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-holo-card";

props.name: issuer
props.description: Issuer wordmark, top left of the front.

props.name: tier
props.description: Tier name, set in italic serif.

props.name: holder
props.description: Cardholder name, upper-cased on the card.

props.name: number
props.description: Full number on the back; the front shows the last four.

props.name: expiry
props.description: Expiry, MM/YY.

props.name: since
props.description: Member-since year.

props.name: finePrint
props.default: Follows the issuer, plus a return address
props.description: Two lines of fine print on the back. The first names the issuer.

props.name: finish
props.description: Metal finish: base reflectance, edge polish and etch colour.

props.name: side
props.description: Controlled side. Omit to let the card manage it.

props.name: defaultSide
props.description: Initial side when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSideChange
props.description: Called when the card is flipped.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Pointer and device-orientation tilt. Flipping always works.

props.name: onReveal
props.description: Fires once as the card starts its turn-in on first view, so surrounding UI can follow it in.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which fills its parent.

name: Keycaps
description: Sculpted Three.js keycaps that drop onto their plate in reading order, then answer your real keyboard: caps sink on a spring and chords like ⌘K show a caption.
usage: import { ThreeKeycaps } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-keycaps";

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows of caps, back row first (up to 10 caps). Each: id, label or glyph, sub word, KeyboardEvent codes, width in units, tone.

props.name: chords
props.description: Key-id combinations that light together and show a caption.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the accent-tone cap, and (28% lighter) the LED light that bleeds from beneath a pressed cap.

props.name: palette
props.description: The neutral cap plastics and legend ink: a preset name, or your own { alpha, mod, legend } colours (graphite is { alpha: "#34353a", mod: "#232428", legend: "#e6e6e6" }). Changing it recolours the caps in place.

props.name: demo
props.description: Press ⌘K once by itself the first time the caps come into view.

props.name: listen
props.description: Mirror the physical keyboard while the caps are on screen (ignored while typing in a field).

props.name: pressed
props.description: Key ids held down from outside, joined with "+" ("cmd+k"): the caps sink and the chord's caption shows, as if typed. Anything that names no key lets go.

props.name: showCaption
props.description: Show the caption row under the caps. The chord is still announced to screen readers when it is off.

props.name: captureShortcuts
props.description: Prevent the default action of a completed chord (e.g. ⌘K). Off by default so the host page's own shortcuts still work.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which fills its parent.

name: Material Inspector
description: A finish study in Three.js: one bevelled coupon under a studio light, with finishes that cross-fade, meters that glide and a key light you swing.

props.name: title
props.description: The sample's name in the toolbar.

props.name: path
props.description: Breadcrumb before the title.

props.name: materials
props.description: 1–8 finishes: { id, label, description, color (#rrggbb), metalness 0–1, roughness 0.15–1, transmission? 0–0.8 }.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled view { materialId, azimuth (−90…90, whole degrees), lightAngle (0…359) }.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial view when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first finish at 22° under a 315° light.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every requested view. Throw to refuse it; the current view stays.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: A finished interaction the host accepted: a drag released, a key let go, a finish chosen, Reset.

props.name: quality
props.description: Drawing-buffer budget: 480k or 960k pixels, DPR capped at 1.5 or 2, 2048px a side.

props.name: theme
props.description: Chrome and studio backdrop.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the view; the finish and its parameters stay readable.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Particle Sphere
description: A Three.js sphere of 14,000 grey shader-lit particles that condense from a loose cloud on first view, wrapped in a self-drawing orbit. Touch tints it with one accent.
usage: import { ThreeParticleSphere } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-particle-sphere";

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: particles swelling under the pointer and the ripple a click sends. The sphere itself is grey.

props.name: density
props.description: Particles on desktop; halved under 640px.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier.

props.name: turbulence
props.description: Noise displacement strength, 0–1.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lean toward the pointer, swell under it and ripple on click.

props.name: ring
props.description: Show the orbiting particle ring.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the host element, which fills its parent.

name: Voice Orb
description: A dark-glass voice orb whose rim draws itself on first view. One accent burns brighter per state as it listens to your mic, swirls in thought and pulses as it speaks.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled state. Omit to let the built-in segmented control drive it.

props.name: defaultState
props.description: Starting state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called when the control or the mic button changes state.

props.name: name
props.description: The assistant’s name, used in the idle caption and labels.

props.name: captions
props.type: { idle?: string; listening?: string; thinking?: string }
props.description: Caption per state. Mic status lines (waiting, blocked, missing) override listening.

props.name: speakingLines
props.description: Lines voiced by the synthetic speech envelope; the caption lights up word by word in sync with the pulses.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the orb's inner light and halo, the state dots and the mic level ring. States change its brightness (idle 35%, listening 100%, thinking 65%, speaking 85%), never its hue.

props.name: showControls
props.description: Show the state segmented control and the microphone button.

props.name: showCaption
props.description: Show the eyebrow and caption under the orb.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Tilt the orb gently toward the pointer.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element.

name: Token Usage Meter
description: An AI usage meter for one budget cycle: a stacked bar by model, a tick that warms past 80%, and the day the budget runs out at this pace.

props.name: title
props.description: The small label above the figure.

props.name: used
props.description: Share of the cycle budget already used, in percent (0 to 120). Past 100 the budget is exceeded and the readout says by how much.

props.name: models
props.description: Segments on the bar, 1 to 4. The top models keep their own segment and the rest fold into Other models. 1 shows one total.

props.name: catalog
props.description: Each model's share of tokens and its price in dollars per million tokens. Shares are normalised.

props.name: budget
props.description: The cycle budget in tokens. Credits are 1,000 tokens each; dollars are priced from the catalog.

props.name: unit
props.description: What the bar and the figures count in. The bar's segments resize to the chosen unit.

props.name: softLimit
props.description: Percent of the budget where the tone shifts. The tick and its label warm, and the stretch of bar or projection past it gets an accent edge; the palette stays put.

props.name: cycleStart
props.description: First day of the cycle, ISO date. Used for the forecast and the day marker.

props.name: cycleEnd
props.description: Last day of the cycle, ISO date, inclusive.

props.name: today
props.description: The day the forecast is made on, ISO date. Pass the real date in production.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for compact numbers, dates and currency.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code shown when the unit is dollars.

props.name: forecast
props.description: Show the run-out forecast and the what-if slider beneath the legend. The slider speeds up the daily pace from today on; the share used never changes.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the forecast date, the tone past the soft limit and the what-if thumb.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink. Light deepens the accent for text so it stays readable on paper.

name: Hover Work Index
description: A dark studio work index in huge type: rows stagger in as their rules draw, and on desktop a cover card follows the cursor on springs, tilting with velocity.

props.name: projects
props.description: year, client, discipline, href, cover art key, and an optional chip colour (defaults to accent).

props.name: title
props.description: Section title.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Mono label above the title.

props.name: intro
props.description: Short intro beside the title.

props.name: previewLabel
props.description: Chip label on the floating card.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column labels over the rows on wide containers.

props.name: accent
props.description: Fill of the active row's arrow chip and the focus ring.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black or paper. Covers keep their own colours.
